Review a User's Access Rights

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn how to see which groups a user belongs to and so which apps and actions that person is allowed to use.

1. Open Settings

Open the Settings app.

2. Users & Companies

Open the Users & Companies menu.

3. Users

Click Users.

4. Open a user

Click any user to open the record.

5. Access rights tab

Look at the Access Rights tab. Click it to continue.

6. Groups count

Click Groups to open the full list of groups.

7. Groups list

These are all the groups. Click the column headings to finish.
